A box whose width $x$ is $3$ times its depth $z$ has a manufacturing cost that depends on two materials. The material for the top and bottom costs $$5$ per square foot, and the material for the lateral faces costs $$2$ per square foot. The box must have a volume of $50\,{ft}^{3}.$

What is the value of $z$ for the box that has the smallest production cost?
